job.job_description:
We are hiring Full Stack Developers to design, build and scale the systems that power NavGurukul''s learning and community platforms

In this role, you will work across the stack from intuitive frontends to resilient backends collaborating with product, design and AI/ML teams to launch impactful features and build for scale, security and performance
You will design and ship full-stack applications, build responsive component-driven frontends using React.js/Next.js/Vue and craft robust backends with Node.js, Express or Python (Flask/Django), develop and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs, design and optimise relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), implement DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, monitoring), and mentor junior developers
We are looking for strong programming skills across front-end and back-end, expertise in designing and integrating RESTful APIs, hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, and proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or similar)
We are primarily hiring senior-level engineers with 7+ years of experience for senior leadership / CTO roles, but if you have solid backend or frontend experience and meet 60% of the technical requirements, we encourage you to apply


Location - Remote- Bengaluru,Hyderabad,Delhi / NCR,Chennai,Pune,Kolkata,Ahmedabad,Mumbai
